page_title: BAR 3-0 GET | Barcelona v Getafe 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and David Soria pulls off an easy save.

90+2' Nice individual effort by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). He gets all the way to the goalkeeper, produces a strike towards the right side of the target, but David Soria does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out with a save.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
88' Davinchi (Getafe) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Joan Garcia.
85' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.

85' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) replaces Gerard Martin.
80' Substitution. Adrian Liso makes his way off the pitch and Alex Sancris (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
79' A lofted cross from Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
76' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) replacing Pedri.
75' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
74' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:14.
70' Substitution. Mauro Arambarri walks off the pitch and Coba da Costa (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
69' The attendance for today's match is 5711.
68' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by David Soria.
67' 10:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:1.
62' 3 - 0 Dani Olmo (Barcelona) controls a great pass, looks up and fires in a tremendous goal-bound shot from mid-range, but it's blocked by a defender.
60' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Frenkie de Jong will be replaced by Marc Casado (Barcelona).
60' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ferran Torres.
60' A decent effort by Dani Olmo (Barcelona) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
58' The referee is firm and issues Abdel Abqar (Getafe) a deserved yellow card.

55' Luis Milla (Getafe) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
54' This is a yellow card! Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
52' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
51' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
50' Luis Milla (Getafe) prepares to take a corner kick.
49' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
48' Javier Munoz (Getafe) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mario Martin (Getafe) is replaced by Javier Munoz.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Davinchi comes on the pitch for Djene (Getafe).
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has made a change at the break. Abu Kamara has come on in place of Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Marcus Rashford and Raphinha (Barcelona) is off.
46' Referee Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Referee Ricardo De Burgos has finally had enough of Jose Bordalas Jimenez and brandishes a yellow card at him!
44' Djene (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
43' A great pass puts Ferran Torres (Barcelona) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
43' Adrian Liso (Getafe) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

41' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. David Soria guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
40' Barcelona are seeing far more of the ball now.
38' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) tries to find Raphinha, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

34' 2 - 0 GOAL! Raphinha finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Ferran Torres (Barcelona), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from mid range. It’s 2:0.
34' The corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared away by the defence.
32' Raphinha (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
31' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and signals a foul after Diego Rico (Getafe) brought his opponent down. Barcelona are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:0. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
30' A long pass, executed by Djene (Getafe), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
28' Pedri (Barcelona) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Robert Lewandowski.
25' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo De Burgos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), but the defence gets it clear.
18' Mario Martin (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
17' Mario Martin (Getafe) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
16' 73:27 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Dani Olmo plays a pass to the feet of Ferran Torres (Barcelona), and he shoots into the top left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
14' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Raphinha (Barcelona).
14' Pedri (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Barcelona have a corner.
11' The free kick is taken by Luis Milla (Getafe), but ball is cleared.
10' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle after Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
8' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
4' Raphinha (Barcelona) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
3' Mario Martin (Getafe) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
3' A clumsy foul by Mario Martin (Getafe) and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle. Barcelona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
3' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

2' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos will officiate today.
